Why AI

The model is the artist. The studio is the editor.

Every piece is produced by a generative model built on No Sleep's own visual references, then reviewed by the studio before it's eligible to mint. Nothing ships that doesn't look like it belongs in the same room.

  • ModelCustom-trained, No Sleep dataset
  • RenderGenerated at mint, not pre-rendered
  • ReviewStudio curation before reveal
  • MetadataOn-chain, Robinhood Chain
  • ProvenanceModel + prompt logged per piece
What chain is this on?+

Robinhood Chain. You'll need a wallet configured for Robinhood Chain and a small amount of gas to cover the free claim.

How do I qualify for the free mint?+

The 1,000 free claims are reserved for the Night Shift community and early signal subscribers, one per wallet, first come first served until the allocation is gone.

What happens to the reserved 1,000?+

They're held back from the initial sale entirely — used for the studio treasury, partner collaborations, and future Night Shift airdrops. None are sold at launch.

Is this financial advice?+

No. NFTs are volatile, illiquid, and can lose all value. Only mint with what you can afford to lose — see the disclosure in the footer.

Referral program

How a launch plays out

Three stages, no manual steps

01

Curve trading

Buyers and sellers trade directly against the bonding curve. No pool to seed, no liquidity to provide — price moves with demand from the first buy.

02

Graduation

Once the curve raises 4 ETH, the contract automatically opens a Uniswap pool on Robinhood Chain and seeds it with the raised liquidity — plus 100% of whatever tax accumulated during the curve, added in the same transaction. No one can stall or skip this step.

03

Open trading

The token trades freely on the DEX like any other pair, with LP locked or burned on-chain at the moment of migration.

04

Referral payout

If a referrer was attached at deploy, they take 30% of every trade fee this token ever generates — curve and post-graduation alike — automatically, with no expiry and no action required from them.

Launch and trade from X

Never leave the timeline

Launch by tweet

Deploy without opening the app

Link your X account once. Then post a tweet tagging @nosleepbot with a name, ticker, and an image attached, and the bot deploys it on Robinhood Chain in the same block, replying with the live chart link.

@nosleepbot launch "Fault Line" $FAULT — community-launched, fair curve, no presale. [image attached]
Trade by reply

Buy and sell from any reply

Reply to a token's launch tweet or any of its price-update tweets with a plain-language order, and the bot executes it against your linked wallet — no swap screen required.

@nosleepbot buy 0.25 ETH of $FAULT
Orders placed this way still pay the standard 2.0% curve fee, and still credit whichever referrer is attached to that token — the tweet is just an alternate front end for the same on-chain trade. Wallet-linking and order confirmation happen once via DM, and every executed order gets a public reply with the tx hash so it stays verifiable.
